answer_1.quote: We repeated the human evaluation of a mixed set of movie and product review translations produced by three leading Machine Translation (MT) systems ... Annotators were asked to mark up translations first for Comprehensibility, then for Adequacy, distinguishing two levels of severity for each: major errors ... and minor errors ...

answer_4.quote: All evaluators in both studies were fluent in the source language and native speakers of the target language ... Annotators were given detailed guidelines, a practice round, and instructed to mark major issues with red colour and minor issues with blue colour.
answer_4.guideline: Detailed guidelines with practice texts; annotators mark major errors in red and minor errors in blue.
